mathematics.assertion_tested: For the explicit mimetic multiplier clock action, the nonzero-density FLRW branch has a generic second-class primary/secondary pair and one reduced clock configuration degree of freedom in both k=0 and k!=0 reduced Fourier sectors; its FLRW density scales as a^-3.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact symbolic rational functions over SymPy symbols; illustrative Einstein-aether numbers are rational substitutions.
mathematics.conventions: Metric signature (-+++); S_clock = -1/2 integral sqrt(-g) lambda (g^mu nu d_mu phi d_nu phi + 1); positive lambda is positive dust density; reduced-sector Poisson brackets use (phi,p_phi),(lambda,p_lambda).

bounds.background: flat FLRW reduced clock sector with a>0, N>0, lambda nonzero
